PR149_ASTRA_JOURNAL_POLICY_V1

For PR #149, Astra must persist every major completed phase to GitHub, not only the final result.

Use TWO layers of persistence:

1. Rolling resume state: keep `PR149_ASTRA_CHECKPOINT_V1` current so a later session can immediately resume from the latest state.
2. Append-only phase history: after each completed phase, add a new PR comment headed `PR149_ASTRA_PHASE_V1` recording that phase's exact evidence. Do not overwrite/remove earlier phase comments.

- WORKTREE_RECOVERED

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Ignore task-body marker text during correlation**

When an otherwise valid delegated task contains a correlation token such as `WORKER_TASK_V1`, `delegation_id=`, or `task_sha256=`, `build_worker_prompt` embeds that text verbatim, but this loop treats every occurrence anywhere in the rendered prompt as an envelope marker. The exact prompt is therefore sent successfully, then delivery correlation fails, the committed claim becomes `unknown`, and the worker result cannot be captured. Scope marker parsing to the protocol envelope or reject/encode reserved task text before Send rather than interpreting task data as correlation authority.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L44-L48](https://github.com/BogdanAIP/chat-agent-platform/blob/3f0210a63f4ac225bd74c5e979f87504900505e2/AGENTS.md#L44-L48)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject disabled contenteditable composers**

When ChatGPT exposes its editor as a contenteditable element with `aria-disabled="true"`, this guard checks the disabled state only in the `TEXTAREA` branch, so the disabled editor is accepted as the sole live composer. If it is empty, cleanup can stabilize and mint capture authority despite there being no eligible current editor; the equivalent pre-Send filter in `content.js` has the same branch structure. Check disabled and `aria-disabled` state for every candidate before the tag-specific eligibility test.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L203-L208](https://github.com/BogdanAIP/chat-agent-platform/blob/3f0210a63f4ac225bd74c5e979f87504900505e2/AGENTS.md#L203-L208)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Closed on exact HEAD `02919bec1a8814dc1402c1c2aa9885ff723ec6c9` by commit `02919bec1a8814dc1402c1c2aa9885ff723ec6c9` (`fix(agent-sessions): bind task envelopes and current capture eligibility`). The producer now digest-binds the task body with `TASK_BEGIN:<task_sha256>` / `TASK_END:<task_sha256>`, while post-Send correlation parses the ordered outer header and excludes the bounded task body from authority marker validation. New production-behavior regression `tests/test_chatgpt_temporary_envelope_editor_runtime.py` covers task-body `WORKER_TASK_V1`, `delegation_id=`, `delivery_id=`, `task_sha256=`, malformed/duplicate markers, provider decoration, ambiguity, and CRLF/LF. Focused suite: 148 PASS. Exact-head hosted `ci` also ran 1118 tests PASS; all 8 required hosted workflows are green.

Closed on exact HEAD `02919bec1a8814dc1402c1c2aa9885ff723ec6c9` by commit `02919bec1a8814dc1402c1c2aa9885ff723ec6c9`. Composer eligibility is now centralized in `policy.js::eligibleComposerEditor()` and reused by both pre-Send `content.js` and post-delivery cleanup/capture selection. Disabled/read-only/inert/hidden state, including `aria-disabled="true"` on contenteditable elements, is rejected across the editor ancestry before tag-specific eligibility. The same batch also requires a single visible form-owned live editor. New production-behavior regression covers disabled textarea, textarea aria-disabled, contenteditable aria-disabled, aria-hidden, disconnected/zero-rect, inherited disabled state, multiple live editors, and synchronous capture recheck. Focused suite: 148 PASS. Exact-head hosted `ci`: 1118 tests PASS; all 8 required hosted workflows are green.
